title: Actions
description: Every action's input and output. Generated by `pnpm --filter @template/contracts build`; don't edit.

profile.get.title: Get profile
profile.get.description: Get the signed-in person's profile: name, job title, email, whether the email is verified, and their company and role.

profile.update.title: Update profile
profile.update.description: Change the signed-in person's name or job title. Email changes need the verification link, so they're made in the browser.

organization.get.title: Get company
organization.get.description: Get the company this connection is for: its name, slug, and the caller's role and permissions there.

organization.update.title: Update company
organization.update.description: Rename the company or change its slug (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens). Owners and admins.

organization.transferOwnership.title: Transfer ownership
organization.transferOwnership.description: Make another member the owner. The current owner becomes an admin, and both get an email.

organization.leave.title: Leave company
organization.leave.description: Leave the company. The last owner can't leave until someone else is an owner. The session opens another company, if the person has one.

organization.delete.title: Delete company
organization.delete.description: Delete the company: every member loses access at once, connections are revoked and automations stop. It can be restored by support for 30 days, then it's gone.

members.list.title: List members
members.list.description: List the company's members: name, email, job title and role.

members.updateRole.title: Change a member's role
members.updateRole.description: Change a member's role (owner, admin or member). Admins can promote members to admin but can't change other admins or owners; only owners can make someone an owner. A company always keeps at least one owner.

members.remove.title: Remove a member
members.remove.description: Remove someone from the company. They lose access at once: their sessions here end and their connected apps for this company are disconnected.

invites.list.title: List invitations
invites.list.description: List the company's pending and expired invitations.

invites.create.title: Invite someone
invites.create.description: Email someone an invitation to join the company as a member or an admin. The link works for 7 days. Inviting an address that already has a pending invitation sends it again.

invites.resend.title: Resend an invitation
invites.resend.description: Send an invitation again with a new link (the old link stops working) that works for another 7 days.

invites.revoke.title: Revoke an invitation
invites.revoke.description: Cancel an invitation, so its link stops working.

automations.list.title: List automations
automations.list.description: The company's automations, with their last run, and the approvals waiting on the person.

automations.catalog.title: Automation catalog
automations.catalog.description: What the person may compose into an automation: triggers, steps and actions.

automations.get.title: Get an automation
automations.get.description: An automation's draft, published versions, revisions and problems.

automations.create.title: Create an automation
automations.create.description: Start a new automation with an empty draft.

automations.saveDraft.title: Save an automation's draft
automations.saveDraft.description: Save a full definition as the next draft revision. A save based on an older revision is refused.

automations.restore.title: Restore a draft revision
automations.restore.description: Make an earlier draft revision the current draft again.

automations.delete.title: Delete an automation
automations.delete.description: Delete an automation and stop its runs.

automations.publish.title: Publish an automation
automations.publish.description: Publish the reviewed draft revision as the next version, run as the publisher.

automations.setPaused.title: Pause or resume an automation
automations.setPaused.description: Pause a published automation, or resume it if its published version still works.

automations.simulate.title: Simulate an automation
automations.simulate.description: Run the draft against a sample payload with every effect simulated.

automations.liveTest.title: Test an automation for real
automations.liveTest.description: Run a draft revision once with real effects, after the person confirmed them.

automations.run.title: Run an automation
automations.run.description: Start a manual automation with its trigger's fields.

automations.runs.title: List an automation's runs
automations.runs.description: An automation's recent runs, newest first.

automations.getRun.title: Get a run
automations.getRun.description: A run's steps, approvals and outcome.

automations.cancelRun.title: Cancel a run
automations.cancelRun.description: Stop a run that hasn't finished.

automations.decideApproval.title: Approve or decline
automations.decideApproval.description: Decide an approval step a run is waiting on, as one of its approvers.

automations.webhook.title: Get an automation's webhook
automations.webhook.description: The webhook trigger's URL and signing secret.

automations.rotateWebhook.title: Rotate a webhook secret
automations.rotateWebhook.description: Replace the webhook trigger's signing secret; the old one stops working.

zapier.list.title: List Zapier connections
zapier.list.description: The company's Zapier connections, inbound and outbound.

zapier.create.title: Add a Zapier connection
zapier.create.description: Add an inbound connection (its secret is returned this once) or an outbound Catch Hook.

zapier.update.title: Change a Zapier connection
zapier.update.description: Rename a connection, or turn it on or off.

zapier.delete.title: Remove a Zapier connection
zapier.delete.description: Remove a connection; automations that use it are paused.

zapier.regenerateSecret.title: Regenerate a connection's secret
zapier.regenerateSecret.description: Replace an inbound connection's secret; the old one stops working.

zapier.events.title: List a connection's events
zapier.events.description: An inbound connection's recent events and the runs they started.

zapier.sendTestEvent.title: Send a test event
zapier.sendTestEvent.description: Send a test event through the inbound pipeline; it starts nothing.

zapier.sendTest.title: Send a test to a Catch Hook
zapier.sendTest.description: Post a sample body to an outbound connection's Catch Hook.

assistant.config.title: Assistant settings for the panel
assistant.config.description: Whether the Assistant is on here, its models and the default.

assistant.conversations.title: List conversations
assistant.conversations.description: The person's own Assistant conversations here, newest first.

assistant.deleteConversation.title: Delete a conversation
assistant.deleteConversation.description: Delete one of the person's own Assistant conversations.

assistant.usage.title: AI spending
assistant.usage.description: This month's AI spend, today's requests and the limits.

assistant.saveSettings.title: Change AI settings
assistant.saveSettings.description: Set the default model, the monthly budget and the daily request cap.
